name: perf-king-golden
js: (async () => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); document.getElementById('btn-toggle-hud')?.click(); app.teleportTo(-1050, -349, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-1050, 6, -351], look: [-300, 4, -349], fov: 40 }); const T = app.trafficSystem; if (!T.__wrapped) { const orig = T.update; T.__acc = 0; T.__n = 0; T.update = function (...a) { const t = performance.now(); const r = orig.apply(this, a); T.__acc += performance.now() - t; T.__n++; return r; }; T.__wrapped = true; } await sleep(7000); T.__acc = 0; T.__n = 0; const f = []; let last = performance.now(); const t0 = last; await new Promise((res) => { (function tick(now) { f.push(now - last); last = now; if (now - t0 < 6000) requestAnimationFrame(tick); else res(); })(performance.now()); }); f.shift(); f.sort((a, b) => a - b); const mean = f.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / f.length; console.log('[perf] perf-king-golden frame ' + mean.toFixed(2) + ' ms p95 ' + f[Math.floor(f.length * 0.95)].toFixed(2) + ' ms traffic.update ' + (T.__acc / Math.max(1, T.__n)).toFixed(3) + ' ms/frame' + (C.SIGNALS ? ' tracked ' + C.SIGNALS.stats.tracked + ' actuated ' + C.SIGNALS.stats.actuated : '')); })()
